content_sections.heading: About MGU
content_sections.text: Mahatma Gandhi University is located at Nalgonda (508 254) and is described in the notice as re-accredited with B+ by NAAC. The notice, dated 17.11.2026, is issued by the Registrar. The posts are for the Department of Commerce, and applications are received at the University College of Commerce & Business Management.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice does not mention the pay for the Part-Time faculty. It states that the appointments are purely temporary and on a stop-gap arrangement basis for the academic year 2026–27.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MGU Part-Time faculty (Department of Commerce)
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates are advised to submit their applications to the Principal, University College of Commerce & Business Management, Arts Block, MGU. The application must be submitted on or before 21.11.2026 before 4.00 pm, with copies of certificates of experience (if any) enclosed. The notice does not mention an application form, an email address or a mode of sending.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointments are purely temporary and on a stop-gap arrangement basis. Preference will be given to candidates with Ph.D / NET / SET qualification along with teaching experience. The qualification must be from a UGC recognised University.
